real.explanation: The median (midsagittal) plane passes through the midline and divides the body into equal right and left halves.

why_others_wrong.b: Coronal (frontal) plane divides anterior and posterior sections.
why_others_wrong.c: Paramedian plane is parallel to the median plane but does not bisect the body equally.
why_others_wrong.d: Horizontal (transverse) plane divides superior and inferior parts.

real.explanation: The coronal (frontal) plane is a vertical plane that separates the body into anterior (ventral) and posterior (dorsal) sections.

why_others_wrong.a: Horizontal planes are transverse/axial, not coronal.
why_others_wrong.c: Upper and lower division is done by the transverse plane.
